subject: Migrate ziplist.c unit tests to new framework (#486)
reason: The change is a pure test migration: it moves ziplist.c's SERVER_TEST-gated unit tests into the new unit test framework (src/unit/test_ziplist.c, test_files.h) and deletes the old #ifdef SERVER_TEST block from ziplist.c/ziplist.h plus its entry in server.c's serverTests[]. No production code path, command behaviour, reply, encoding, or persistence logic changes — only code compiled for the test harness — so no server-facing scenario can exercise the change.
